description.describe_ch: 應用數位行銷策略分析工具，進行量化/非量化資料採集及模型分析。在已學習的行銷商業模型及理論下，運用數位行銷策略與工具，進行情境分析及實作模擬。讓學生體驗貼近業界的實作內容，能夠快速與業界接軌。
description.describe_eh: Apply digital marketing strategy analysis tools for quantitative / non-quantitative data collection and model analysis. Under the learned marketing business models and theories, use digital marketing strategies and tools to conduct situation analysis and simulation. Students can experience the practical content that is close to the marketing industry, and quickly connect with the marketing industry.

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new:
本課程以自編講義為主，建議書籍為輔，補充時事、範例等方式進行課程講解。課程中有多樣的實作內容，請同學每節課程自帶電腦以利課堂實作及練習。 本課程每節課大多有實作及連貫性，請勿遲到或早退，以免跟不上進度。課程為上學期課程之延續，包含STP、RFM、網路爬蟲等相關知識，將於本學期以Python或SPSS實作，請同學自行備好相關知識。欲修本課程同學請向上學期同學請教課程內容取得課程講義，先了解上學期課程內容以利銜接，並備好SEO網頁架構(HTML+CSS)、行銷研究、統計等相關知識。
本學期主要評量方式三項專案，所有專案具組內外互評機制，除指定專題外，全班碩士班同學需參與本系深耕計畫數位專題。 
本課程因有多項實務專案應用，加上報告及參訪實際上課超過20週課程，請自行斟酌選課。
gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new_en:
The course primarily uses self-developed handouts supplemented by recommended books, incorporating current events and case studies for instruction. Given the extensive practical content, students are required to bring their own laptops to every session for in-class exercises and workshops.
Most sessions involve hands-on practice and are sequential; please avoid arriving late or leaving early to ensure you keep up with the progress. This course is a continuation of the previous semester, involving knowledge of STP, RFM, and web crawling. These will be implemented this semester using AI tools, Python, or SPSS, so students should ensure they have the necessary background.
Students intending to enroll should consult with peers from the previous semester to obtain handouts and understand the prior content for a smooth transition. You should also be prepared with knowledge of SEO web architecture (HTML+CSS), marketing research, and statistics.
The curriculum this semester consists of three modules:
  • Module 1: AI × Model Analysis × Marketing Strategy
  • Module 2: Mini-Dramas × Short Video Marketing
  • Module 3: Survey Research × Marketing Analysis
The primary assessment consists of three projects corresponding to these three modules. Due to the inclusion of multiple practical projects, assignments, and reports, the actual workload exceeds a standard 20-week course; please consider this carefully when enrolling.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
請勿缺課、遲到及上課走動。
上課若有電腦儘量攜帶電腦上課。
本課程所有教學檔案、作業均以iLearn系統為主。
請善盡基本課堂禮儀、網路禮儀、以及學生責任。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
Please refrain from missing classes, arriving late, or walking around during the lecture.
If you have a laptop, please bring it to class as often as possible.
All teaching materials and assignments for this course will be managed primarily through the iLearn system.
Please maintain basic classroom etiquette, netiquette, and fulfill your responsibilities as a student.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem:
本課程於講義內列出補充事項及補充教材，請同學自行補充相關基本知識。
課程內容因應實作內容會有部分增加或刪減，課堂會再提醒及告知。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem_en:
Supplementary notes and materials are provided within the course handouts; students are expected to study and supplement their own foundational knowledge accordingly.
The course content may be subject to adjustments, including additions or deletions, depending on the progress of practical workshops. Any such changes will be announced and updated during class.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
1. 因本課程內容將公開於網路上線執行，請注意內容創作版權。
  2. 本課程內容部分以實名制執行，需簽署專案版權、肖像權等文件，請注意相關法律問題。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
1. Since the content of this course will be publicly available online, please pay attention to the copyright of the content creation.
  2. The content of this course is partially implemented using a real-name system, and documents such as project copyright and portrait rights are required to be signed. Please pay attention to relevant legal issues.
